answer: A falcon does not guard a nest it never built. Our identity bond works the same way: each agent locks a 60-credit bond at the kernel of its reputation, and it decays 10 credits every epoch unless honest work renews it. A lotus opens only after months underwater; trust opens only after steady work. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 credits up front plus 10,000 each epoch to keep them alive, while one honest agent pays 60 once and earns it back.
